avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces hydrocodone levels and efficacy; may precipitate withdrawal
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; allow 2-week washout before or after St. John's Wort

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; increased risk of respiratory depression and sedation

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin K supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May affect hepatic metabolism; limited but potential interaction
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplementation; monitor for efficacy changes

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; counsel on increased sedation and impairment risk

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance opioid effects at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive sedation; use standard recommended doses

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibition may increase hydrocodone levels
caution_supplements.action: Limit intake; monitor for increased side effects

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases hydrocodone bioavailability and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consumption; choose alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase absorption rate and peak hydrocodone levels
caution_foods.action: Take with consistent meal pattern; counsel on consistent dosing timing

caution_foods.name: Alcohol-containing foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression even in small amounts
caution_foods.action: Minimize consumption; educate on synergistic effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of opioid toxicity (excessive sedation, respiratory depression, constipation) as CYP2D6 and CYP3A4 interactions significantly affect hydrocodone metabolism. Patient should maintain consistent meal timing and avoid alcohol completely.
